scope: Correction of stage-3C scientific role, reference-conditioned candidate and independent limited challenges; not a completed Earth-like morphology model

assumptions: static shared Voronoi support is not the tectonic plate population
connected recursive graph cuts, not a mantle/strain-driven fragmentation law
support count controls generating boundary scale; changed support is a new prior

acceptance.source_motion_allowance_reason: 0.001-degree endpoint rounding and 0.1 mm/a table rounding; a source-resolution bound, not a changed solver tolerance
acceptance.distinction: area agreement is calibration; matching local kinematic formulae is not validation of generated global plate velocities

independent evolutionary and geological validation; W03 and W01 stages5-8 are not implemented here

historical geometry identities and authored inputs
